name: sonor-cinema-aesthetic-greystones-tools
description: Headless tools beside the Nano Banana runner — handoff-headless.mjs (render handoff packages), b546-apply-1392.mjs (one-off canon write), cdp.mjs (zero-dependency Chrome DevTools driver). NO npm packages: the Mac's npm sits behind a TLS-intercepting proxy, so everything runs on Node 22 built-ins + the installed Google Chrome.
